summary: Declare repository labels as generated configuration, preserving existing labels and proposing design-feedback and top-priority signals

replay.detail: Only repository label configuration changes; no runtime replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated runtime upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, provider, or harness contracts change.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption is needed for repository label configuration.

manual.detail: After maintainer agreement and merge, a repository maintainer must apply the generated label configuration through the label reconciler or equivalent GitHub API updates. Existing labels are retained; no label migrations or deletions are declared. Runtime installations need no action.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery behavior changes.
